# Punarnava Ayurvedic Hospital

> Ayurvedic hospital in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, India, specialising in Panchakarma treatments and Ksharsutra surgery for anorectal conditions including piles, fissure, and fistula. Established by Dr B.S. Katiyar and Dr Smita Katiyaar with over 15 years of clinical experience.

## Doctors
- Dr B.S. Katiyar — MD (Ayurvedic Medicine, Lucknow), PGCKS — Expert in Panchakarma & Ksharsutra Surgery for piles, fissure, fistula, and anorectal disease
- Dr Smita Katiyaar — MD, B.SC., BAMS — Gynaecologist and Infertility Specialist with expertise in women's Ayurvedic care

## Core Services

### Ksharsutra Surgery
Ayurvedic para-surgical technique for treating piles (haemorrhoids), fistula-in-ano, and anal fissure without general anaesthesia. Recovery: 3–5 days. No recurrence in most cases.

### Panchakarma
- **Poorva Karma** (Preparatory): Snehan (oil therapy), Swedan (steam therapy)
- **Pradhan Karma** (Main treatments): Vaman, Virechan, Basti, Nasya (Shiro-Virechan), Rakta-Mokshan
- **Paschatya Karma** (Post-treatment diet and care)

### Other Therapies
Shiro-Dhara, Janubasti, Greevabasti, Nadi Pariksha, Dhoopan, Natra Basti, massage, spa, beauty care

### Conditions Treated
Piles, fissure, fistula, anorectal disease, digestive disorders, diabetes, joint pain, obesity, skin conditions, infertility, respiratory conditions, stress, anxiety
